items.title: How Much Is Tesla’s Robotaxi Actually Worth?
items.summary: Tesla's Austin geofence just grew, unsupervised miles are surging, and a $1.5 trillion valuation leans heavily on the story. But Robotaxi has no reported revenue yet, so one future earnings report may decide whether the hype holds.

items.title: David Tepper Bought CoreWeave Before It Fell 51%. Is He Wrong, or Early?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoreWeave is down 51% since June 30, the quarter-end of the 13F in which David Tepper’s Appaloosa first reported owning it. It’s the worst of Appaloosa’s buys from that quarter: Meta is up 14% since then, Uber is down 3%, and Taiwan Semiconductor and Boeing are down 17% and 20%.

items.title: Musk: Cybercab Will Do “a Majority of All Passenger Miles.” Uber’s Tiny Margin Is the Target
items.summary: Key TakeawaysElon Musk says Tesla’s Cybercab will do most passenger miles wherever the law allows, six days after Uber posted 20% bookings growth. A robotaxi price fight would hit Uber’s thin profit on each ride first.
